title: Why We Choose a Small Annual Subscription (£11/Year)
summary: We love a good one-off purchase as much as anyone, and for simple products, lifetime access makes total sense! But Neigh Tag isn't just a static product - it's a live, active emergency response system that works for your horse around the clock.
metaDescription: Discover why Neigh Tag's £11 annual subscription keeps your horse's emergency profile online, secure, ad-free, and ready when you need it.
intro: To keep your horse's profile online, lightning-fast, and secure 24/7, we pay ongoing costs for high-speed cloud servers, bank-grade data security, and continuous software updates. By charging a small £11 annual subscription (less than 92p a month), we make a simple commitment to you:

sections.heading: Our commitment to you
list: Guaranteed Reliability: When an emergency happens and a stranger scans your tag, you can trust that the profile will load instantly, every single time.
Long-Term Sustainability: We don't cut corners on server quality or system security as our community grows over the years.
Privacy: Your data stays completely private. We will never sell your details to cover our costs.

sections.heading: Peace of mind, year after year
paragraphs: We believe that peace of mind comes from knowing your emergency system is actively managed, supported, and ready when you need it most.
